_설명: 천일문 3권 워크북 Chapter 02 조동사의 Chapter Test를 변형한 것. 심화 4과 조동사 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: must = have to / don’t have to: ~할 필요가 없다
used to+동사원형: ~하곤 했다 (be used to와 구별)
must/may/cannot have p.p.: 과거 일에 대한 추측

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: You ________ book the tickets. I’ve already done it.

choices.text: must not
shouldn’t
don’t have to
used to
had better

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: Daniel ________ be my classmate, but I don’t know which school he goes to now.

choices.text: can
will
had better
used to
should

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: I read a wonderful novel last night. I ________ it earlier!

choices.text: should read
must read
have to read
should have read
must have read

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 영작한 것으로 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: 지호는 서점에서 점원으로 일했었다. → Jiho used to work as a clerk at a bookstore.
소라는 나에게서 독감을 옮았음이 틀림없다. → Sora must have caught the flu from me.
민호는 연설 중에 실수를 했을지도 모른다. → Minho may have made a mistake during the speech.
그 공연에 내 남동생을 데리고 갔어야 했다. → I should bring my brother to the concert.
유나가 도서관에서 나를 봤을 리가 없는데 내가 종일 집에 있었기 때문이다. → Yuna cannot have seen me at the library because I was at home all day.

questions.point_label: used to와 be used to -ing의 구별
questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • This website ____(A)____ data for my report.
• Sumin ____(B)____ soda a lot, but now she only drinks water.

choices.text: used to collect — was used to drink
was used to collect — used to drink
used to collect — was used to drinking
was used to collecting — used to drink
was used to collect — was used to drink

questions.prompt: 밑줄 친 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: A: Why do Mina and Sora not talk to each other?

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: Bears will come out of their caves again next spring.
My grandfather was used to drink herbal tea every morning.
Sora burned her hand on the pot. She should have been careful.
You’d better not call him by that nickname. He doesn’t like it.
Jiho didn’t come to my graduation. He must have forgotten about it.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 문맥상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: I should have reviewed my notes before I took the quiz.
Mina traveled around Europe last summer. She may have gone to Spain.
Tom cannot have known my address. I’ve never told it to him.
My aunt must have been very busy. She didn’t call us for a month.
Sora felt so hungry. She must have eaten lunch.

questions.point_label: had better의 부정은 had better not
questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 너는 어떤 뜨거운 것도 네 남동생에게 주지 않는 것이 낫다.
(give / better / anything hot / not / had / you)
questions.answer: You had better not give anything hot

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 나는 어쩌면 그 파일을 실수로 지웠을지도 모른다. 그것을 찾을 수 없다.
→ ________________ by mistake. I can’t find it.
questions.answer: I might have erased the file

questions.prompt: 다음 글에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: We have to cancel our field trip yesterday because it snowed a lot.

questions.prompt: 다음 글에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: This hall used be a famous concert hall. It is a library now.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 짝지어진 대화가 어법상 어색한 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: A: What should I do to sleep better?  B: You had better avoid coffee at night.
A: The science test was too hard. Did you pass it?  B: No, we should study harder to pass it.
A: Mom, did you see my apple pie on the shelf?  B: Your sister may have eaten it.
A: I used to feel very shy in front of a crowd.  B: Oh, that must have been hard.
A: Jiho cannot have texted me because he has broken his phone.  B: Really? Maybe he borrowed one.

questions.prompt: 다음 대화를 읽고 주어진 단어를 사용하여 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: Mina: Dad, did you wash my jacket?
Dad: Yes, I washed and hung it on the balcony.
Mina: Oh, no! I ________________ my earphones out of the pocket! (take)
